in_arabic.name: Iba
in_arabic.long_meaning: Iba هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'iba', meaning 'to rise above' or 'to exalt'. In Islamic tradition, Iba represents the sublime and exalted nature of Allah and His prophets.
